question: Which witnessed rosters, finite counts, and whole-stage knots survive the independent recount?
weighting: Enumerate all 23 old starts for all 6 laws. Four mutually sharing starts. First 12 starts after position 1,000 of the archived shuffled five-knot catalog, unconditional on outcome. This is a test panel, with no estimate for other starts.
observable: Members hold at least one unbarred loose distinction. Two distinct members are one step apart if a third knot shares a distinction with both, in the stage prefix. For every member count the members within 0 through r_max witnessed steps, saturating by part. Take the largest count separately at each r over all members. Empty roster gives zero throughout.
predictions: For each mutually sharing start, m>=3, after t>=1: m extra members and all m-term weak compositions of t-1, with unit-transfer steps and one extra neighbor on each pure sum; at t=1 all m attach to the sole sum. m=6, t=13 predicts 6194 members (=C(17,5)+6) and a largest one-step count of 31. Round zero is an explicit control outside this range.

Group one, t>=2: t(t+1)/2+3 members under all six laws, with best count 3r²+3r+1 through 3r<=t-1. Group two, t>=2: C(t+2,3)+4 members under L0/L9/L11; best count (2r+1)(5r²+5r+3)/3 for 4r<=t-1. Test t=1 separately and report any counterexample, including a different early roster.
Under each cap of three, group two splits after the cap acts. Test four or five parts and a best count min(2r+1, largest part size) from t>=2, retaining waiting and offshoot exceptions.

Group three L0/L9: predict best count 12r²+2 for 1<=r<=floor((t-2)/3) on the late panel t>=20 (at 41 predict 2030 at r=13). Group four L0/L9: 48r²−48r+24 for 2<=r<=floor((t-4)/3), t>=20 (at 31 predict 3480 at r=9). For each capped law test a loss of this whole roster. Report actual breakpoints and the first failure, including earlier or larger r as descriptive.

Heldout cases: no prediction that all widen. Predict agreement of all roster counts and every individual whole-stage knot under both knot laws as a falsifiable claim. Any failure of a knot is retained, and limits the interpretation of its roster.
methods: Independently grow every start under both knot laws and the designated fresh-count law, including genuine parity closing. Producer and recount share only the registered inputs, not implementation or outputs.

Per reached scheduled stage compare knots, members, unique pairs, descending part sizes, degree histogram, cumulative reach maxima and SHA256 of compact JSON of sorted per-member vectors. Spectra equality supports counts; an isomorphism claim needs its own proof or exact map.

Check every start and made knot projected from the whole stage by existentially removing all other distinctions. Check both knot laws, including exact closure or projection failure, retaining unclassified results. A last-stage extension certificate covers an earlier knot only when justified by monotonicity. Pass K1, K2 and K3 on actual allowed relations, with canonical knotlab CLI and exact independent bookkeeping.
controls: round 0, round 1 common sum, capped variants, new five-knot starts, NAE vs parity, and remove the witnessed steps in a model control: this must change the counts.
For a failed knot report its table or a certificate; never erase a failed knot from the measured roster. Label the physical-incidence count and the count of valid knots.
resources: Post-round knot bound 75000; retain first complete round exceeding bound, then stop. A guard discards an incomplete round. No imputation after stall/end. Rehearse each exact configuration with timing, no outcome used for selection; each runner under memory cap. Shared long-runner for extended batches; if projected longer than about one hour per run, file a pre-run resource deviation for the longest affordable prefix in cases.json order and retained stages. No negative from omitted cells. Raw traces may be deterministically regenerated.
decision: Report agreement only for completed matching cells. An unmatched number is never a finding. Report first differences, all unrun cells and limitations separately. Experiments do not prove the uniform statement.
